subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should Wear OS adopt the Home-first three-picker navigation and make `model-controls` with `models.list`/`models.select` the supported additive Phone companion contract?
rationale: The patch is a user-facing navigation redesign plus a new inter-app protocol surface, so correctness tests cannot determine whether this is the intended long-term Wear product and compatibility direction.

options.title: Accept the Home-first contract
options.body: Approve the navigation redesign and additive capability-gated model controls, then require an exact-head rebase and Android/Wear validation refresh before merge.

options.title: Keep the existing navigation
options.body: Retain dedicated Agent and Session pages and request a narrower improvement that does not add the new model-control companion contract.

options.title: Split protocol from UI
options.body: Land or review the capability-gated model contract separately, then decide the Home navigation redesign with a smaller focused UI change.

recommendation.title: Accept the Home-first contract
recommendation.body: Approve the navigation redesign and additive capability-gated model controls, then require an exact-head rebase and Android/Wear validation refresh before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and the supplied branch history shows direct recent work hardening the affected Android/Wear behavior.
